tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a Manufacturer OR Authorized Dealer OR Distributor of Transformer Oil. 1.In case the bidder is a Manufacturer a.Valid documentary proof such as license issued by Commerce and Industries Department or any other Government Statutory Authority shall be uploaded.2.In case of Authorized Dealer and Distributor a.Manufacturing license of Original Manufacturer b.Valid authorization letter from the original Manufacturer assuring full guarantee, warranty as per the tender conditions, from the Manufacturer shall be uploaded

The Bidder should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in Manufacturing, Supplying Or Distribution of Transformer oil as on date of bid submission. Documents to be uploaded, Scanned copy of Purchase orders or Order Completion certificate issued by Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities and PSUs, demonstrating experience of 3 years shall be uploaded.

In case of original Manufacturer The Bidder should have obtained orders for at least 80 percent , however 40 percent to Micro and small Enterprises of the tendered quantity of Transformer oil in any one of the last 3 preceding years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 however last 2 years i.e., 2023-24 and 2024-25 for Micro & Small Enterprises to Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities,PSUs.2. In case of Authorized Dealer, Distributor The Original Manufacturer should have obtained orders at least 80per however 40percent in respect of Micro, Small Enterprises of the tendered quantity of Transformer oil in any one of the preceding 3 years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (last two years i.e., 2023-24 & 2024-25 for Micro & Small Enterprises) to electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs. The Authorized Dealer, Distributor should have should have obtained orders at least 30percent of the tendered quantity of Transformer oil in any one of the preceding 3 years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 to electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities,PSUs. Documents to be uploaded are 1.In case of OEM Scanned copies of Purchase Orders in the name of Original Manufacturer issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical utilities,PSUs shall be uploaded. W.r.to Micro and Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME Udyam registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that the Bidder is a Micro and small Enterprises.2.In case of Authorized Dealer,Distributor a.Scanned copies of Purchase Orders in the name of Original Manufacturer issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities,PSUs shall be uploaded. W.r.to Micro and Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME UDYAM registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that Bidder is a Micro and small Enterprises. b. Scanned copies of Purchase orders in the name of Authorized Dealer, Distributor issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical utilities,PSUs shall be uploaded.

In case of Original Manufacturer The Bidder should have manufactured, tested and supplied at least 80 percent however 40percent in respect of Micro and Small Enterprises of the tendered quantity of oil in any one of the preceding 3 years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 however last two years i.e., 2023-24 and 2024-25 for Micro and Small Enterprises to electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities, PSUs. 2.In case of Authorized Dealer OR Distributor a.The Original Manufacturer should have manufactured, tested and supplied at least 80 percent and 40 Percent in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises of the tendered quantity of Transformer oil in any one of the preceding 3 years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 however last two years i.e., 2023-24 & 2024-25 for Micro & Small Enterprises to electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities, PSUs. And b.The Authorized Dealer, Distributor should have supplied at least 30percent of the tendered quantity of Transformer oil in any one of the preceding 3 years i.e 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 to electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities, PSUs.Documents to be uploaded are.1.In case of OEM- Scanned copies of Order completion certificates in the name of Original Manufacturer issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical utilities,PSUs shall be uploaded. W.r.to Micro and Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME -UDYAM registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that the Bidder is a Micro and small Enterprises.2.In case of Authorized Dealer, Distributor a. Scanned copies of Order completion certificates in the name of Original Manufacturer issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities,PSUs shall be uploaded. W.r.to Micro and Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME UDYAM registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that Bidder is a Micro and small Enterprises. b.Scanned copies of Order completion certificates in the name of Authorized Dealer, Distributor issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical utilities, PSUs shall be uploaded.

The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following a. Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act 1956 /2013 including any amendment there to b. LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership LLP Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto c.Partnership Firm under Partnership Act 1932 in India d.Sole Proprietorship Concern. Documents to be uploaded are .a.i.Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956 /2013 along with Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company. ii. Declaration from Directors of the Company in MBP-1 Form stating that they are not disqualified to be a Director of the Company along with the list of Companies in which they are Directors as on the date of inviting tender (s).b. i. Certification of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per LLP Act 2008. ii. Limited Liability Partnership Agreement of LLP. c i. Partnership Deed, GST Registration certificate. ii. Shops & Establishment Registration certificate, as applicable. d.i.PAN/GST Registration certificate.

Bidder shall upload the type test certificates for having conducted all the type tests mentioned in the relevant IS, Technical specification on Transformer Oil at CPRI Or ERDA and such type test reports shall not be older than five years as on the last date of bid submission. Documents to be uploaded are Valid type test certificates from CPRI or ERDA shall be uploaded.Note In case of Authorised Dealer Or Distributor type test certificate of original Manufacturer shall be uploaded

The Bidder should not be under Default OR debarred OR blacklisted by any Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities, PSUs, as on the date of bid submission.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500. by the Bidder adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

Litigation History, The Bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, a consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder or any partner may result in rejection of Bid.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500. shall be uploaded.The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done

Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority.(As per Government Order No. FD 455 Exp-12/2020 dated 25.08.2020.) Scanned copy of Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded regarding Boarder sharing or not. If the Bidder is from a country which shares a land with India, Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted/uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format: I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India. I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfils all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached.) Scanned copy of the self-declaration in the prescribed format on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Bidder shall not be less than the Amount Put to Tender However it will be 50percent in respect of Micro and Small Enterprises during the preceding 3 financial years i.e. 2022-23 2023-24 and 2024-25 However, it will be last 2 years i.e. 2023-24 and 2024-25 for Micro & Small Enterprises. Certified copies of Audited Financial Statements such as P and L Statement, Balance Sheets for the required FYs shall be uploaded.

The Liquid Assets as on 30.099.2026 or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus Availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized OR scheduled Bank shall not be less than 25percent of the amount put to tender. The cash at Bank, Bank Deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized Or Scheduled Bank shall be uploaded. If the Bidder has banking with more than one Bank, then the available balance liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on 31.01.2026 or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date and time for all the banks.In case of Fund Based credit facility, the certificate issued by Nationalized OR Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on 31.01.2026 or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded.The certificate shall be submitted in the format as per Annexure
